title: Kitchen Cabinet Planner with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file implementing an interactive 3D kitchen cabinet planner with time-of-day lighting control using Three.js.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 10), looking at the origin.
- Create a kitchen room environment: a floor plane (20x20 units, color #8B7355 wood-tone), back wall (20x8 units, color #F5F5DC), and two side walls.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and a directional 'sun' light that changes position/color based on time of day.
- Load the GLB model 'TextureTransformMultiTest.glb' using THREE.GLTFLoader from a CDN. Scale it to (0.8, 0.8, 0.8) and position it at (0, 1.5, -2). This serves as a decorative countertop appliance/object.
- Use OrbitControls for camera interaction.

## Cabinet System
- Create 5 cabinet slots along the back wall, evenly spaced from x=-6 to x=6, each slot 2 units wide.
- Each slot can hold one of 3 cabinet types: 'upper' (box 1.8x2x0.8, positioned at y=4), 'lower' (box 1.8x2.5x1, positioned at y=1.25), or 'tall' (box 1.8x5x1, positioned at y=2.5).
- Cabinets use MeshStandardMaterial. Default color: #8B4513 (brown). Selected cabinet highlight: #DAA520.
- Initially, place 'lower' cabinets in slots 0,1,2 and 'upper' cabinets in slots 3,4.

## Cabinet Interactions
- Click on a cabinet to select it (highlight it). Only one cabinet selected at a time.
- Press 'Delete' key to remove the selected cabinet from its slot (slot becomes empty).
- Press '1' to place/change selected slot to 'lower' cabinet, '2' for 'upper', '3' for 'tall'.
- Press 'C' to cycle cabinet color through: #8B4513 (brown), #FFFFFF (white), #2F4F4F (dark slate), #D2691E (chocolate). This applies to the selected cabinet only.

## Time-of-Day Control
- Add a horizontal slider (HTML range input) at the bottom of the screen, id='timeSlider', min=0, max=24, step=0.5, default value=12.
- Label it with a span id='timeLabel' showing 'Time: 12:00'.
- The slider controls the sun light: at hour=6 sunrise (position x=-10,y=2,z=0, color #FFA500, intensity 0.5), hour=12 noon (position x=0,y=10,z=0, color #FFFFFF, intensity 1.0), hour=18 sunset (position x=10,y=2,z=0, color #FF4500, intensity 0.5), hour=0/24 night (light intensity 0.05, color #191970).
- Interpolate smoothly between these keyframes.
- Add a 'Play' button (id='playBtn') that auto-advances time at 1 hour per second. Toggle to 'Pause' when playing.

## Cost Calculator
- Display a cost panel (div id='costPanel') in the top-right corner.
- Lower cabinet costs $200, upper costs $150, tall costs $350.
- Show total cost, cabinet count, and average cost per cabinet.
- Update in real-time when cabinets are added/removed/changed.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- cabinetSlots: array of 5 elements, each null or {type: 'lower'|'upper'|'tall', colorIndex: 0-3}
- selectedSlot: index of selected slot or -1
- totalCost: number
- cabinetCount: number
- averageCost: number (0 if no cabinets)
- currentTime: number (0-24, from slider)
- sunIntensity: number (current directional light intensity)
- sunColor: string (hex color of sun light)
- isPlaying: boolean (time auto-advance state)
- glbLoaded: boolean (true when model loaded)
- glbPosition: {x, y, z} of the loaded model
- removedCount: number (total cabinets removed this session)

Ensure all state values are never NaN. Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Cabinet positions must snap to predefined slot positions. Sun light interpolation must be smooth and bounded (intensity 0.05-1.0). Cost calculations must be exact integers. Time must wrap or clamp within 0-24 range.
